test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The dacoit was shot __from up close__ by the police officer.
solution:
The solution is **Point blank.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate idiom for 'from up close' is **point blank.**
 
• The dacoit was shot **point blank** by the police officer.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about ***idioms:*** 

 
 
• A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words
